name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Small, marginal, and all landholding farmer families across India
short_description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of farmer families.
full_description: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. It aims to supplement the financial needs of landholding farmers in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields, commensurate with the anticipated farm income.
benefits: ₹6,000 per annum paid in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly transferred via DBT into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

key_rules: Applicant must be a landholder farmer family with cultivable land in their name in state land records.
Institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, serving/retired government officers, and income tax payers in the last assessment year are excluded.
Bank account must be Aadhaar-linked with e-KYC completed.

required_documents: Active Mobile Number for OTP verification
application_process: 1. Visit PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). 2. Submit New Farmer Registration with Aadhaar and Land Khatauni details. 3. Complete biometric or OTP-based e-KYC. 4. Verification by State Nodal Officer.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & PM-KISAN Portal
tags: farmer, dbt, direct benefit, agriculture, kisan, income support, crop input

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
short_description: Comprehensive risk insurance cover against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
full_description: PMFBY provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage against losses caused by natural disasters, pests, and diseases. Farmers pay a nominal uniform premium of 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops, with the balance subsidized by the Government.
benefits: Full sum insured payout based on threshold yield deficit. Comprehensive cover for localized calamities, prevented sowing, mid-season adversity, and post-harvest losses within 14 days of harvest.

key_rules: Must be growing notified crops in notified insurance areas during the designated season.
Non-loanee farmers must provide land ownership documents or registered tenancy/sharecropper agreement.
Loss intimation must be submitted within 72 hours of localized disaster (hailstorm, landslide, inundation).

required_documents: Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Village Agricultural Officer
application_process: 1. Apply via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in) or through bank branch / CSC / insurance intermediary. 2. Select crop season, district, and survey number. 3. Pay farmer share of premium. 4. Policy receipt generated immediately.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & PMFBY National Portal
tags: crop insurance, disaster relief, fasal bima, drought, flood, hailstorm, farmers

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Farmers, individual/joint cultivators, tenant farmers, self-help groups, animal husbandry and fisheries farmers
short_description: Timely access to affordable institutional credit with concessional interest rates for agricultural, animal husbandry, and fisheries operations.
full_description: Kisan Credit Card facilitates short-term credit requirements for cultivation of crops, post-harvest expenses, consumption requirements of farmer households, working capital for maintenance of farm assets, and activities allied to agriculture. Farmers receive interest subvention of 2% and prompt repayment incentive of 3%, bringing effective interest rate down to 4% p.a. on loans up to ₹3 Lakh.
benefits: Short-term credit up to ₹3,00,000 at effective subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum upon prompt repayment. Collateral-free loan up to ₹1.60 Lakh (extended to ₹2 Lakh for tie-up). Flexible revolving cash credit.

key_rules: Individual or joint borrower farmers who are owner cultivators or legal tenants.
Co-applicant mandatory if applicant age is above 60 years.
Animal husbandry and fisheries farmers are eligible for working capital limit up to ₹2 Lakh within the overall ₹3 Lakh ceiling.

required_documents: Land title deeds / revenue records / lease agreement
No Dues Certificate (if borrowing beyond collateral limit)
application_process: 1. Fill 1-page simplified KCC form at commercial bank, RRB, cooperative bank, or online on JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in). 2. Submit land documents and KYC. 3. Bank sanctions credit limit within 14 days and issues RuPay KCC card.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & Department of Financial Services (DFS)
tags: kcc, credit card, loan, subsidized interest, farm loan, working capital, animal husbandry

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)
name_hindi: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना - प्रति बूंद अधिक फसल
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: All farmer categories adopting micro-irrigation (Drip and Sprinkler systems)
short_description: Financial subsidy of 55% for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers to install precision micro-irrigation systems.
full_description: PDMC focuses on enhancing water use efficiency at farm level through micro-irrigation technologies like drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. It promotes precision water management, reduces fertilizer wastage via fertigation, and improves crop yields significantly.
benefits: Financial assistance of 55% of benchmark cost for Small and Marginal farmers, and 45% for other farmers for installing drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.

key_rules: Applicant must possess cultivable agricultural land with assured water source (borewell, open well, canal, or farm pond).
Beneficiary must not have received micro-irrigation subsidy for the same survey number in the preceding 7 years.
Small and marginal farmers receive higher subsidy support (55%).

required_documents: Water Source Proof / Electricity Connection Certificate
Soil and Water Test Report (where mandated by state)
application_process: 1. Register on state horticulture/agriculture portal or micro-irrigation MIS portal. 2. Select empanelled micro-irrigation manufacturer. 3. Field inspection by Agriculture Officer. 4. Subsidy released directly to farmer account or vendor upon installation verification.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & PMKSY Official Portal
tags: irrigation, drip irrigation, sprinkler, water saving, subsidy, horticulture, farm efficiency

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs) owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares aged 18 to 40 years
short_description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme providing assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after reaching 60 years of age.
full_description: PM-KMY provides social security to small and marginal farmers in their old age. Farmers contribute a monthly amount ranging between ₹55 to ₹200 depending on entry age (18 to 40 years), with an equal matching contribution made by the Central Government. The pension fund is managed by Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC).
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 directly deposited into bank account upon reaching 60 years of age. Family pension of 50% (₹1,500/month) to spouse in case of subscriber death.

key_rules: Must be a small or marginal farmer with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares in state land records.
Must be aged between 18 and 40 years at time of enrolment.
Should not be covered under other statutory social security schemes like NPS, ESIC, EPFO or PM-SYM.
Income tax payees are excluded.

required_documents: Khasra/Khatauni land record proving landholding up to 2 hectares
Savings Bank Account Passbook / Cheque for auto-debit
application_process: 1. Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or self-enrol via maandhan.in. 2. Provide Aadhaar and bank account details. 3. System calculates monthly contribution based on age. 4. Auto-debit mandate signed and Kisan Pension Card issued.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & Ministry of Agriculture
tags: pension, small farmer, social security, monthly pension, old age, maandhan, lic

name: PM-KUSUM (Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
target_audience: Individual farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, water user associations, and panchayats
short_description: Up to 60% subsidy for setting up standalone off-grid solar agriculture pumps and solarization of grid-connected agriculture pumps.
full_description: PM-KUSUM scheme enables farmers to de-dieselise the agricultural sector and generate income from barren/uncultivable land. Component-B provides 30% Central Financial Assistance and 30% State subsidy for installing standalone solar agriculture pumps up to 7.5 HP, with farmers contributing only 40% (or 10% cash + 30% bank loan).
benefits: 60% subsidy (30% Central Govt + 30% State Govt) on standalone solar water pumps. Farmer pays only 10% upfront, with remaining 30% available as bank loan. Reliable daytime irrigation and zero electricity/diesel bills.

key_rules: Applicant must possess agricultural land with an existing water source (borewell/open well).
For standalone pumps (Component B), area must be non-grid connected or suffering from irregular power.
Beneficiaries must have valid land title or certified tenancy rights.

required_documents: Electricity connection certificate (or declaration of no grid connection)
application_process: 1. Apply online via state nodal renewable energy agency portal (e.g. RREC in Rajasthan, MEDA in Maharashtra). 2. Submit land documents and pump HP requirement. 3. Pay farmer share (10% to 40%). 4. Certified vendor installs solar pump and tests water discharge.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & MNRE Official Portal
tags: solar pump, renewable energy, irrigation, kusum, electricity, agriculture, green energy

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Small, marginal, SC, ST, and women farmers seeking modern farm machinery
short_description: 40% to 50% financial subsidy on procurement of tractors, power tillers, rotavators, harvesters, and establishment of Custom Hiring Centres.
full_description: SMAM aims to increase the reach of farm mechanization to small and marginal farmers and to regions where availability of farm power is low. It promotes Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) to offset high cost of purchasing equipment for individual farmers.
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on purchase of agricultural machinery (up to ₹1.25 Lakh on small tractors/power tillers, and up to ₹10 Lakh subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centres).

key_rules: Applicant must be an active farmer possessing registered agricultural land.
Women, SC, and ST farmers are accorded higher priority and 50% subsidy rate.
Only one tractor/power equipment subsidy permitted per family within a 7-year block.

application_process: 1. Register on DBT Agricultural Mechanization portal (agrimachinery.nic.in). 2. Select implement and upload dealer quotation. 3. Approval by District Agriculture Department. 4. Purchase machine and receive DBT subsidy in bank account.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & Department of Agriculture
tags: tractor subsidy, farm machinery, mechanization, rotavator, power tiller, custom hiring centre

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
target_audience: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, JLGs, fisheries cooperatives, and entrepreneurs
short_description: 40% to 60% financial assistance for aquaculture pond construction, biofloc, RAS, boats, nets, and cold chain logistics.
full_description: PMMSY is an umbrella scheme to bring about the Blue Revolution through sustainable development of the fisheries sector in India. It addresses critical gaps in fish production, productivity, quality, technology, post-harvest infrastructure, and modernization of the value chain.
benefits: Financial grant of 40% of project cost for General category and 60% for SC, ST, and Women beneficiaries across freshwater aquaculture, biofloc, cold storage, and motorization of traditional fishing crafts.

key_rules: Applicant must possess own land or minimum 7-10 years leasehold rights for pond/RAS construction.
Coastal fishers must have registered fishing vessel license with fisheries department.
Women, SC, and ST applicants receive maximum 60% subsidy rate.

required_documents: Land / Pond ownership or lease agreement
application_process: 1. Apply on PMMSY portal (pmmsy.dof.gov.in) or submit proposal to District Fisheries Officer (DFO). 2. Scrutiny by District Level Committee (DLC). 3. Sanction letter issued. 4. Release of phased milestone subsidy via DBT.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & Department of Fisheries
tags: fisheries, aquaculture, fish farming, biofloc, blue revolution, boat subsidy, fisherman

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
target_audience: Dairy farmers, rural youth, private entrepreneurs, FPOs, and cooperatives
short_description: Up to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Crore) for establishing breed multiplication farms and sex-sorted semen facilities.
full_description: Rashtriya Gokul Mission is implemented for development and conservation of indigenous bovine breeds, genetic upgradation of the bovine population, and enhancement of milk production and productivity. It provides capital subsidies to entrepreneurs for setting up modern dairy breeding farms.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹2 Crore for setting up Breed Multiplication Farms (minimum 200 indigenous cows/buffaloes) and 50% subsidy up to ₹25 Lakh for silage making units and high-yielding heifer units.

key_rules: Applicant must possess land (minimum 5 acres for 200 cows) or long-term registered lease.
Must arrange remaining 50% project cost through bank loan or self-financing.
Entrepreneur must have relevant experience or certified training in dairy farming/animal husbandry.

required_documents: Bank loan sanction letter (for loan-linked portion)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) approved by veterinary consultant
application_process: 1. Apply online through National Livestock Mission / RGM portal (nlm.udyamimitra.in). 2. Submit DPR and bank sanction. 3. Appraisal by State Livestock Development Board and approval by Central Monitoring Committee.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & DAHD Portal
tags: dairy, cattle breeding, indigenous cow, gokul mission, milk production, animal husbandry

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Farmer clusters, SHGs, and traditional farmers transitioning to organic cultivation
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years to adopt organic farming and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
full_description: PKVY promotes organic farming through a cluster approach and PGS-India certification. It supports organic input production, on-farm composting, packaging, organic branding, and linkage to domestic and international organic markets.
benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is given directly via DBT for organic inputs (bio-fertilizers, vermicompost, botanical extracts) and ₹19,000 for cluster formation, PGS certification, and marketing.

key_rules: Farmers must form a cluster of minimum 20 hectares (or 50 farmers) in contiguous agricultural land.
Individual farmer ceiling for assistance is 2 hectares.
Commitment to discontinue synthetic chemical fertilizers and pesticides.

required_documents: Cluster Member Resolution / Farmer Group Agreement
application_process: 1. Mobilize farmer cluster and register through District Agriculture Officer / Regional Lead Agency. 2. Register group on PGS-India portal (pgsindia-ncof.gov.in). 3. Periodic peer appraisals and DBT input credit.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & INM Division, MoAFW
tags: organic farming, biofertilizer, vermicompost, pgs certification, sustainable agriculture, pkvy

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, Agri-entrepreneurs, and start-ups building post-harvest infrastructure
short_description: 3% per annum interest subvention on bank loans up to ₹2 Crore for setting up cold storage, warehouses, sorting/grading units, and silos.
full_description: AIF provides a medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. Loans have an interest subvention of 3% p.a. for up to 7 years and credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE for loans up to ₹2 Crore.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on term loans up to ₹2 Crore for up to 7 years. Credit guarantee fee paid by government under CGTMSE. Repayment moratorium up to 2 years.

key_rules: Project must create post-harvest management infrastructure or community farming assets.
Interest subvention available on maximum loan of ₹2 Crore per project (up to 25 projects across different locations).
Borrower must obtain formal bank loan sanction from participating commercial/cooperative banks.

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with financial viability
Land ownership / long lease document for facility site
application_process: 1. Register on AIF portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in). 2. Submit DPR and select preferred lending bank. 3. Ministry scrutiny within 7 days. 4. Bank disburses loan with integrated 3% interest subvention.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & Department of Agriculture
tags: cold storage, warehouse, food processing, agri infrastructure, interest subsidy, loan, post harvest

name: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: All farmers cultivating agricultural land across India
short_description: Free soil nutrient testing and customized fertilizer recommendation card issued to every farmer every 3 years.
full_description: The Soil Health Card scheme assesses the nutrient status of soil across 12 parameters: N, P, K (macro-nutrients); S (secondary nutrient); Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo (micro-nutrients); and pH, EC, OC (physical parameters). It provides crop-wise fertilizer dosage recommendations to lower input costs and prevent soil degradation.
benefits: Free diagnostic report on 12 soil parameters with customized dosage recommendations for urea, DAP, micronutrients, and bio-fertilizers. Helps cut input costs by 15-20% and improve yields by 10-15%.

key_rules: Farmer must hold agricultural land in the village grid selected for cycle testing.
Soil sample collected by Agriculture Extension Officer in presence of farmer.

application_process: 1. Approach local Village Agriculture Assistant / Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK). 2. Soil sample taken from field with GPS coordinates. 3. Laboratory testing conducted. 4. Printed Soil Health Card delivered or downloaded via soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & Department of Agriculture
tags: soil health, fertilizer, nutrient management, crop yield, free testing, soil health card

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (PMS-SC)
name_hindi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए मैट्रिक उपरांत छात्रवृत्ति
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_audience: Scheduled Caste (SC) students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages
short_description: Full compulsory non-refundable tuition fees and annual maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500 transferred directly via DBT.
full_description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. Covers full academic fees and monthly maintenance allowances according to course groupings (Group 1 to 4).
benefits: 100% reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees (tuition, library, exam fees) directly to institution, plus annual academic maintenance allowance ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹13,500 per year directly to student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

key_rules: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) community.
Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh per annum.
Student must have passed Matriculation / Class 10 and be enrolled in a recognized post-secondary course in an accredited college/university.
Must not be recipient of any other central/state government scholarship.

required_documents: Valid Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority
Current Income Certificate (less than 1 year old)
College/University Fee Receipt and Admission Letter
application_process: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR (One-Time Registration). 2. Submit PMS-SC application with academic and fee details. 3. Verification by Institution Nodal Officer (INO). 4. Verification by District/State Nodal Officer and DBT disbursement.
source: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) & MoSJE
tags: scholarship, sc, post matric, college, university, fees, maintenance allowance, nsp

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC / EBC / DNT Students
name_hindi: अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (ओबीसी) के छात्रों के लिए मैट्रिक उपरांत छात्रवृत्ति
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_audience: Other Backward Class (OBC), Economically Backward Class (EBC), and De-Notified Tribes (DNT) students in post-matric studies
short_description: Financial assistance covering college tuition fees and study maintenance allowance up to ₹10,000 per year.
full_description: Centrally sponsored scheme to provide financial assistance to OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage. Aimed at substantially increasing Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) of disadvantaged backward classes in higher education.
benefits: Maintenance allowance up to ₹10,000 per annum for hostellers (₹5,000 for day scholars) along with reimbursement of mandatory non-refundable study fees charged by recognized institutions.

key_rules: Applicant must belong to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EBC, or DNT category.
Total annual parental/family income must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh.
Enrolled in recognized undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, or professional courses.

required_documents: OBC Non-Creamy Layer / EBC Caste Certificate
Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
application_process: 1. Apply via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Complete institute level e-verification. 3. District Welfare Officer approval. 4. DBT payment directly to student account.
source: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) & MoSJE
tags: scholarship, obc, ebc, non creamy layer, higher education, college fees, maintenance

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (PMS-ST)
name_hindi: अनुसूचित जनजाति के छात्रों के लिए मैट्रिक उपरांत छात्रवृत्ति
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_audience: Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing recognized post-secondary education
short_description: Complete tuition fee coverage and monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for tribal students in higher education.
full_description: Centrally sponsored scheme dedicated to tribal youth to support higher educational pursuits from class 11 through post-graduate and doctorate levels. Eliminates economic hurdles for ST youth across India.
benefits: 100% compulsory tuition fee reimbursement directly to institution, plus maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month (hosteller) and ₹550/month (day scholar), book grants, and study tour allowances.

key_rules: Applicant must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST).
Total annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Studying in a recognized government or private UGC/AICTE approved educational institution.

required_documents: Fee receipt and Institute Verification form
application_process: 1. Register on NSP (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Submit PMS-ST application. 3. College verification through INO login. 4. State Tribal Welfare Department approves and sanctions funds via DBT.
source: National Scholarship Portal & Ministry of Tribal Affairs
tags: scholarship, tribal, st, higher education, college, tribal welfare, fees

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_audience: Meritorious students of economically weaker sections studying in Class 9 to 12 in Government/Local Body schools
short_description: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) scholarship from Class 9 to 12 to arrest school dropout rates after elementary level.
full_description: Centrally sponsored scheme launched by Department of School Education and Literacy to award 100,000 scholarships each year to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts at class 8 and encourage continuation of secondary education.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000/month) transferred directly to student's bank account via DBT from Class 9 to Class 12 (4 continuous years upon satisfactory academic renewal).

key_rules: Student must have scored minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in Class 7 examination.
Total annual parental income must not exceed ₹3,50,000.
Must qualify the state-level NMMSS selection test conducted in Class 8.
Must be studying in Government, Local Body, or Government-aided school (KVS, NVS, and private residential schools are excluded).

required_documents: NMMSS Selection Examination Merit Roll Card
Bonafide Student Certificate from School Headmaster
Bank Account Passbook in student's name
application_process: 1. Appear and qualify State-level NMMSS written test. 2. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 3. School Headmaster verifies enrollment in Class 9. 4. Yearly renewal on NSP on scoring minimum 55% in subsequent classes.
source: National Scholarship Portal & Department of School Education and Literacy
tags: school scholarship, nmmss, merit scholarship, class 9 to 12, dropout prevention, dbt

name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_audience: OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Class 9, 10, 11, and 12 in Top Class identified schools
short_description: Scholarship of ₹75,000 per year for Class 9-10 and ₹1,25,000 per year for Class 11-12 covering school tuition and hostel fees.
full_description: PM-YASASVI is an umbrella scheme by MoSJE for Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-Notified Nomadic Tribes (DNT). It offers top-class school education scholarships covering full school tuition, hostel, and study material fees.
benefits: ₹75,000 per annum for Class 9 and 10 students; ₹1,25,000 per annum for Class 11 and 12 students studying in identified top-class schools across India.

key_rules: Applicant must belong to OBC, EBC, or DNT category.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh.
Must be studying in one of the identified Top Class Schools listed on the YASASVI portal.

application_process: 1. Apply online on National Scholarship Portal under PM-YASASVI Top Class School Education. 2. Selection based on merit / qualifying criteria. 3. School e-verification and DBT payment.
source: myScheme Portal (myscheme.gov.in) & MoSJE
tags: yasasvi, obc scholarship, top class school, school education, class 9 to 12, merit award

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
name_hindi: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_audience: Meritorious students who have completed Class 12 in top 20th percentile and enrolled in regular degree courses
short_description: ₹12,000 per year for 3 years of graduation and ₹20,000 per year for post-graduation degree studies.
full_description: Department of Higher Education scheme to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies in college and universities. 82,000 fresh scholarships awarded each year (50% reserved for girls).
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate degree; ₹20,000 per annum at the postgraduate level. For 5-year integrated professional courses, ₹20,000/year paid in 4th and 5th year.

key_rules: Student must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream in Class 12 from state/central board.
Must be pursuing regular (non-correspondence/distance) degree course recognized by AIU/UGC/AICTE.
Total parental annual income must not exceed ₹4.50 Lakh.
Must not be in receipt of any other scholarship.

required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
application_process: 1. Apply on NSP (scholarships.gov.in). 2. System verifies Class 12 board roll number and percentile automatically. 3. College verification. 4. Direct DBT payment to student account.
source: National Scholarship Portal & Department of Higher Education
tags: scholarship, college, university, graduation, merit scholarship, csss, higher education

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_audience: Girl students admitted to first year or second year (lateral entry) of technical degree or diploma courses
short_description: ₹50,000 per year for every year of technical study (Degree or Diploma) to empower girl students in STEM and engineering.
full_description: Implemented by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to provide assistance for advancement of girls pursuing technical education. Covers up to 10,000 scholarships annually across degree and diploma engineering programmes.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study (maximum 4 years for degree and 3 years for diploma) paid as a lump-sum amount towards college fees, computer purchase, books, and equipment.

key_rules: Candidate must be female.
Admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma course OR 2nd year of Degree/Diploma through lateral entry in an AICTE approved institution.
Maximum two girl children per family eligible.
Total family income from all sources must be less than ₹8 Lakh per annum.

required_documents: Central/State admission seat allotment letter for engineering/polytechnic
Affidavit declaring only up to 2 girl children in family availing benefit
application_process: 1. Apply via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Institute Nodal Officer e-verifies enrolment in AICTE approved programme. 3. AICTE releases ₹50,000 directly to student bank account via DBT.
source: AICTE Official Portal & National Scholarship Portal
tags: aicte, pragati, girl student, engineering, diploma, polytechnic, stem, technical education

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Differently Abled Students
name_hindi: एआईसीटीई सक्षम छात्रवृत्ति योजना (दिव्यांग छात्रों हेतु)
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_audience: Specially-abled students with disability not less than 40% studying technical degree or diploma courses
short_description: ₹50,000 per year scholarship for every year of technical study for differently-abled students in AICTE colleges.
full_description: AICTE initiative aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially abled children to pursue technical education. Provides all eligible applicants with financial support to purchase books, software, assistive devices, and meet educational expenses.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for the entire duration of the course (4 years for Degree, 3 years for Diploma) credited directly into Aadhaar-linked bank account.

key_rules: Applicant must possess a valid Disability Certificate with disability percentage of 40% or more.
Enrolled in 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) in AICTE approved technical institution.
Total annual family income must not exceed ₹8.00 Lakh.

required_documents: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card / Medical Board Disability Certificate (>=40%)
Course admission allotment letter and fee receipt
application_process: 1. Submit application on National Scholarship Portal. 2. College verification of technical course admission. 3. AICTE verification and DBT sanction.
source: AICTE Official Portal & National Scholarship Portal
tags: saksham, differently abled, divyang, disability, engineering, aicte, technical education

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
name_hindi: बेगम हज़रत महल राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति योजना
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_audience: Meritorious girl students belonging to notified minority communities studying in Class 9 to 12
short_description: Financial scholarship of ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 per year for minority girl students studying in Classes 9 through 12.
full_description: Implemented by Maulana Azad Education Foundation / Ministry of Minority Affairs to support meritorious girl students belonging to six notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis) who cannot continue their education due to financial distress.
benefits: ₹5,000 per year for Class 9 and 10; ₹6,000 per year for Class 11 and 12, transferred via DBT into student's bank account.

key_rules: Only girl students belonging to six notified minority communities are eligible.
Must have secured minimum 50% aggregate marks in the qualifying previous class.
Total annual parental/guardian income must not exceed ₹2,00,000.
Maximum 2 girls from the same family eligible.

required_documents: Previous Class Marksheet with minimum 50% marks
Income Certificate issued by Competent Authority
School Verification Certificate signed by Principal
application_process: 1. Apply online on National Scholarship Portal. 2. Upload minority declaration and income proof. 3. School head verification. 4. DBT payment release.
source: National Scholarship Portal & Ministry of Minority Affairs
tags: minority, girl scholarship, begum hazrat mahal, class 9 to 12, education support

name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_audience: High-merit Ph.D. scholars in STEM disciplines at IITs, IISc, IISERs, and central universities
short_description: Prestige research fellowship of ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 per month plus an annual contingency research grant of ₹2 Lakh.
full_description: Designed for improving the quality of research in higher educational institutions in the country. Attracts the best talent into research in frontier science and technology areas at premier institutions like IITs, IISc Bangalore, IISERs, and top Central Universities.
benefits: Monthly fellowship of ₹70,000/month (Year 1 & 2), ₹75,000/month (Year 3), and ₹80,000/month (Year 4 & 5), alongside an annual contingency grant of ₹2,00,000 per fellow for research and conference travel.

key_rules: Must be admitted to Ph.D. programme in a PMRF granting institution (Direct Entry or Lateral Entry).
For direct entry: B.Tech/M.Tech with CGPA >= 8.0 or top GATE score.
For lateral entry: Completed 12 to 24 months of Ph.D. with minimum CGPA 8.5 and published research.

required_documents: Letter of recommendation from Ph.D. guide/department
application_process: 1. Institution nominates candidate via PMRF National Portal (pmrf.in). 2. National Review Committee evaluates research proposal and publications. 3. Fellowship awarded by National Steering Committee.
source: PMRF National Portal (pmrf.in) & Ministry of Education
tags: phd, doctoral fellowship, research grant, iit, iisc, science, stem, pmrf

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
target_audience: Top 1% Class 12 students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate education in Natural and Basic Sciences
short_description: ₹80,000 per annum scholarship (₹60,000 cash + ₹20,000 summer mentorship project grant) for 5 years in B.Sc. and M.Sc.
full_description: Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research (INSPIRE) is a flagship programme by Department of Science & Technology (DST). The SHE component offers 12,000 scholarships annually to attract youth towards studying basic and natural sciences at university level.
benefits: Total value of ₹80,000 per annum: ₹60,000 scholarship (₹5,000/month credited annually) plus ₹20,000 mentorship grant for mandatory summer research project under certified scientist.

key_rules: Student must rank within the top 1% cut-off in their Class 12 board examination.
OR qualify within top 10,000 ranks in JEE / NEET and choose B.Sc., B.S., or Integrated M.Sc. in basic sciences.
Eligible disciplines: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Statistics, Geology, Astrophysics, Botany, Zoology.

required_documents: Class 12 Board Marksheet & INSPIRE Board Advisory / Cut-off Certificate
Endorsement Certificate signed by College Principal / University Registrar
application_process: 1. Apply online on INSPIRE web portal (online-inspire.gov.in). 2. Upload endorsement certificate and Class 12 marksheets. 3. DST scrutinizes applications and issues conditional offer letter. 4. Release of ₹80,000/year upon passing examinations with 60% marks.
source: Department of Science and Technology (DST) INSPIRE Portal
tags: inspire, basic sciences, bsc, msc, dst, research scholarship, natural sciences

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
target_audience: Youth who have completed ITI, Diploma, Graduate, or 10th/12th looking for industrial on-the-job apprenticeship
short_description: Government pays 25% of prescribed monthly stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) directly via DBT to apprentices undergoing industrial training.
full_description: NAPS aims to promote apprenticeship training in establishments by providing financial support to both employers and apprentices. Apprentices receive monthly stipends while gaining real-world industry work experience across manufacturing, automotive, IT, and service sectors.
benefits: Government transfers 25% of the stipend payable up to ₹1,500 per month directly to the apprentice's bank account via DBT, while the employer pays the remaining stipend (minimum total ₹7,000 to ₹10,000/month). Apprenticeship certificate issued by NCVET upon completion.

key_rules: Must be at least 14 years of age (18 years for designated hazardous trades).
Must meet minimum educational qualifications prescribed for the trade (e.g. 10th pass, ITI, or graduate).
Must not have undergone an apprenticeship training contract previously in the same trade.

required_documents: Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar Seeded for DBT)
application_process: 1. Register as a Candidate on Apprenticeship Portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in). 2. Complete e-KYC with Aadhaar. 3. Search and apply for apprenticeship vacancies posted by establishments. 4. Sign apprenticeship contract digitally.
source: Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
tags: apprenticeship, naps, industrial training, stipend, iti, skill development, job training

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name_hindi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_audience: Bottom 40% vulnerable families identified by SECC 2011 and senior citizens aged 70 and above
short_description: Cashless health insurance cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
full_description: AB-PMJAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme. It provides a health cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empaneled private hospitals. All senior citizens aged 70 and above are also entitled to a distinct ₹5 Lakh top-up cover irrespective of income.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to 1,949 medical procedures covering diagnostics, surgeries, ICU, implants, medicine, and post-hospitalization for 15 days, up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year. No cap on family size or age.

key_rules: Families listed in the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) database (D1 to D7 deprivation criteria in rural areas and 11 occupational categories in urban areas).
Senior citizens aged 70 and above are universally eligible under the expanded Ayushman Vaya Vandana card regardless of socio-economic status.
NFSA ration card holders in participating states are automatically eligible.

required_documents: Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_process: 1. Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in or beneficiary.nha.gov.in using Aadhaar/Ration Card. 2. Visit any empaneled hospital or CSC. 3. Ayushman Mitra verifies biometrics and issues Ayushman PVC Card / Digital Card.
source: National Health Authority (NHA) & myScheme Portal
tags: ayushman bharat, pmjay, health insurance, hospitalization, cashless medical, free treatment, 5 lakh

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
target_audience: All citizens seeking affordable high-quality generic medicines and surgical items
short_description: Quality generic medicines and surgical consumables sold at 50% to 90% lower prices than branded medicines through Kendra outlets.
full_description: PMBJP was launched by the Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI) to make quality generic medicines accessible and affordable to all. Jan Aushadhi Kendras offer more than 2,000 generic medicines and 300 surgical items conforming to WHO-GMP standards at steep discounts.
benefits: Price reduction of 50% to 90% compared to branded market medicines. Oxo-biodegradable sanitary napkins (Suvidha) available at ₹1 per pad. Blood pressure, diabetes, cardiac, and oncology medicines available at fractional prices.

key_rules: Open to all Indian citizens without any income or category restrictions.
Doctor's prescription required for Schedule H and H1 prescription drugs.
OTC items, nutraceuticals, and sanitary pads available without prescription.

application_process: Walk-in to any of the 10,000+ Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India with prescription, or locate nearest outlet via 'Jan Aushadhi Sugam' mobile application.
source: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)
tags: janaushadhi, cheap medicine, generic medicine, pharmacy, health, suvidha pad, affordable healthcare

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_audience: All pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and sick infants up to 1 year of age
short_description: Completely free and cashless delivery (including C-section), free drugs, diagnostics, blood, diet, and transport.
full_description: JSSK guarantees zero out-of-pocket expenses for pregnant women delivering in government health facilities, including normal deliveries and caesarean sections. The entitlement extends to sick infants up to one year of age accessing public health institutions.
benefits: 100% free delivery and C-section; free drugs, consumables, and diagnostic tests; free provision of blood; free diet during stay (up to 3 days for normal delivery, 7 days for caesarean); and free transport from home to hospital, inter-facility transfer, and drop back home.

key_rules: Must be a pregnant woman accessing care at any public health institution (PHC, CHC, District Hospital, Medical College).
Sick infants up to 1 year of age treated at public facilities are also fully covered.
No income ceiling, caste criteria, or parity limitation.

required_documents: Mother and Child Tracking System (MCTS) / RCH Card (MCP Card)
application_process: Approach any government hospital, Primary Health Centre (PHC), or Community Health Centre (CHC). Contact local ASHA or ANM worker, or call National Ambulance Service (108/102).
source: National Health Mission (NHM) & MoHFW
tags: maternity, pregnancy, free delivery, infant care, jssk, c-section, ambulance, nhm

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_audience: Poor pregnant women delivering in health institutions to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality
short_description: Cash assistance of ₹1,400 (rural) and ₹1,000 (urban) directly to pregnant women upon institutional delivery.
full_description: JSY is a safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission (NHM). It promotes institutional delivery among poor pregnant women through conditional cash transfer. States are categorized into Low Performing States (LPS) and High Performing States (HPS) with special incentives.
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹1,400 for rural mothers and ₹1,000 for urban mothers in Low Performing States (LPS); ₹700 (rural) and ₹600 (urban) for BPL/SC/ST mothers in High Performing States. ASHA incentive of ₹600 included for escorting mother.

key_rules: Delivery must take place in a government health centre or accredited private hospital.
In Low Performing States (e.g. UP, Bihar, Rajasthan, MP, Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand, Assam, J&K), all pregnant women are eligible regardless of age, caste, or birth parity.
In High Performing States, assistance is restricted to BPL and SC/ST mothers up to 2 live births.

required_documents: Discharge slip / Birth certificate from hospital
application_process: 1. Register pregnancy with local ASHA / ANM within first trimester. 2. Undergo required ANC checkups. 3. Deliver baby at public/accredited hospital. 4. Medical Officer sanctions DBT cash payment into bank account prior to discharge.
source: National Health Mission & Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
tags: jsy, institutional delivery, safe motherhood, pregnancy cash transfer, asha, infant care

name: Ni-Kshay Poshan Yojana (NPY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_audience: All notified Tuberculosis (TB) patients undergoing treatment in public or private health facilities
short_description: Direct financial incentive of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per month for nutritional support to TB patients throughout treatment duration.
full_description: Centrally sponsored scheme under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP). Provides nutritional support to tuberculosis patients to combat undernutrition, enhance recovery, and prevent treatment interruption.
benefits: Direct financial transfer of ₹500 per month (recently enhanced to ₹1,000/month in designated categories) deposited directly into the patient's bank account for each month of active anti-TB treatment (minimum 6 months = ₹3,000+).

key_rules: Must be a diagnosed Tuberculosis patient registered and notified on the Ni-kshay web portal.
Both public sector and private sector notified patients are eligible.
Must be undergoing active medical treatment under DOTS / NTEP protocol.

required_documents: Ni-Kshay Patient ID (generated by treating doctor/clinic)
application_process: 1. Patient is diagnosed and notified on Ni-Kshay portal by public dispensary or private doctor. 2. Health worker / Senior Treatment Supervisor (STS) enters patient's bank account details on nikshay.in. 3. Monthly DBT amounts credited directly via PFMS.
source: Central TB Division (CTD) & MoHFW
tags: tb, tuberculosis, nutrition support, nikshay, poshan, dbt, chronic illness, health

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_audience: All pregnant women in their 2nd or 3rd trimester visiting designated public health facilities
short_description: Free, comprehensive, and quality antenatal care (ANC) package on the 9th of every month by OBGYN specialists.
full_description: PMSMA provides assured, comprehensive, and quality antenatal care free of cost to all pregnant women on the 9th of every month. It aims to detect and manage high-risk pregnancies (HRP) early, through expert screening by specialized obstetricians and gynecologists.
benefits: Free comprehensive diagnostic tests (blood, urine, ultrasound, hemoglobin, blood sugar) and expert clinical check-ups by specialist doctors. High-risk pregnancies tagged with red stickers on MCP card for priority referral and institutional delivery tracking.

key_rules: Woman must be pregnant and in her 2nd or 3rd trimester (after 3 months of pregnancy).
Available at designated public health facilities (District Hospitals, Sub-District Hospitals, CHCs, and PHCs) on the 9th day of each calendar month.

required_documents: Previous ultrasound or blood reports (if any)
application_process: Visit the nearest government hospital, CHC, or PHC on the 9th of any month. Register at the PMSMA special registration desk for free clinical examinations and lab investigations.
source: MoHFW & National Health Portal
tags: pregnancy, anc, antenatal care, high risk pregnancy, ultrasound, free checkup, pmsma

name: Intensified Mission Indradhanush (IMI)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_audience: Children up to 2 years of age and pregnant women who missed routine immunization doses
short_description: Free vaccination against 12 vaccine-preventable life-threatening diseases for pregnant women and children up to 2 years.
full_description: Mission Indradhanush aims to ensure full immunization with all available vaccines for children up to two years of age and pregnant women in underserved, remote, and tribal areas. Protects against 12 life-threatening diseases including Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Polio, Measles, Rubella, and Hepatitis B.
benefits: 100% free immunization covering BCG, OPV, Pentavalent, Rotavirus, PCV, MR, and Td vaccines. Prevents childhood mortality and chronic disability.

key_rules: Children from birth up to 5 years of age who have dropped out or missed routine immunization doses.
Pregnant women needing Tetanus and adult Diphtheria (Td) immunization.
No income or category restriction.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Parent (optional, no child denied for lack of ID)
application_process: Approach local Anganwadi centre, Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Day (VHSND) session, or public dispensary during special IMI rounds.
source: Universal Immunization Programme (UIP) & MoHFW
tags: vaccination, immunization, child health, polio, measles, infant care, mission indradhanush

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_audience: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged sections
short_description: Maternity benefit cash incentive of ₹5,000 for the first child and ₹6,000 for the second child (if girl) directly via DBT.
full_description: Centrally sponsored conditional cash transfer scheme implemented under Mission Shakti (Samarthya). It provides partial compensation for wage loss in terms of cash incentive so that the woman can take adequate rest before and after delivery of the first child, and promotes healthy nutrition practices and institutional delivery.
benefits: ₹5,000 in two installments (₹3,000 upon early ANC registration and ₹2,000 after child birth and first cycle of immunization) for the first child. For the second child, ₹6,000 in a single installment if the newborn is a girl child.

key_rules: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child; or for second child if newborn is a girl.
Must belong to eligible categories: SC/ST, Divyangjan, E-shram card holders, BPL ration card holders, PMJAY card holders, or net family income less than ₹8 Lakh.
Women in regular employment with Central/State Govt or PSUs are excluded (as they receive paid maternity leave).

required_documents: Eligibility proof (E-shram card, SC/ST certificate, Ration Card, or Income proof)
Child Birth Certificate (for second installment / second child)
application_process: 1. Apply online via PMMVY Portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in) or submit Form 1A/1B at local Anganwadi Centre / ASHA worker. 2. Verification by Anganwadi Worker (AWW) and Child Development Project Officer (CDPO). 3. Direct DBT credit via PFMS.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development & myScheme Portal
tags: maternity benefit, pmmvy, pregnancy, cash incentive, mother, newborn girl, nutrition, dbt

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_audience: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age
short_description: High-interest (8.2% p.a.) small savings government scheme with Section 80C tax exemption and tax-free maturity for girl's education/marriage.
full_description: Launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, SSY is a dedicated government-backed savings initiative for girl children. It offers one of the highest sovereign interest rates among small savings schemes (8.2% p.a. compounded annually) and complete EEE (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) tax benefits under the Income Tax Act.
benefits: Attractive sovereign interest rate of 8.2% p.a. Minimum deposit of only ₹250/year up to maximum ₹1,50,000/year. Deposits can be made for 15 years, with account maturing after 21 years. Partial withdrawal up to 50% allowed after age 18 for higher education.

key_rules: Account can be opened by natural or legal guardian in the name of a girl child from her birth till she attains 10 years of age.
Maximum of two accounts permitted per family (one for each girl child; exception for twins/triplets).
Account operates till the girl reaches 21 years of age or upon marriage after age 18.

required_documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar Card and PAN of parent/guardian
Passport size photos of child and guardian
application_process: 1. Visit any Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, BoB, etc.). 2. Fill SSY account opening form. 3. Deposit initial minimum amount of ₹250. 4. SSY passbook issued.
source: India Post & Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
tags: sukanya samriddhi, ssy, girl child, high interest, savings, tax exemption 80c, beti bachao

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
target_audience: Adult women belonging to poor households without existing LPG connection
short_description: Deposit-free LPG connection, free first cylinder refill, free hotplate stove, and ₹300 per cylinder targeted subsidy.
full_description: PMUY was launched to safeguard the health of women and children by providing them with a clean cooking fuel (LPG). Under Ujjwala 2.0, beneficiaries receive a deposit-free LPG connection, along with a free first cylinder refill and a free hotplate stove, requiring minimal documentation for migrants through self-declaration.
benefits: Free deposit-free LPG gas connection (security deposit for cylinder and pressure regulator borne by Central Govt). Free first 14.2 kg LPG refill and free gas stove. Ongoing targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder for up to 12 refills per year directly into bank account.

key_rules: Applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 years or older.
There must not be any other active LPG connection in the same household.
Must belong to poor categories: SC/ST, PMAY-Gramin beneficiaries, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Most Backward Classes, Forest Dwellers, Tea Garden Tribes, or 14-point declaration of poor household.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant and adult family members
Ration Card issued by State Govt / Family Composition Certificate
Self-declaration for migrant address proof (if residing away from home)
application_process: 1. Apply online via pmuy.gov.in or visit nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas). 2. Submit e-KYC with Aadhaar. 3. Oil Marketing Company verifies de-duplication. 4. Free cylinder, regulator, pipe, and stove delivered to home.
source: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas & myScheme Portal
tags: ujjwala, lpg connection, gas cylinder, clean cooking fuel, free stove, women health, subsidy

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_audience: Women and SC/ST entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading
short_description: Composite bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Woman and one SC/ST borrower per bank branch.
full_description: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise. The enterprise may be in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading sector.
benefits: Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 repayable in up to 7 years with maximum moratorium period of 18 months. Margin money requirement reduced to 15%. Credit guarantee cover via NCGTC.

key_rules: Borrower must be a Woman OR belong to SC/ST category.
Enterprise must be greenfield (first-time venture of the beneficiary).
In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% of shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
Borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution.

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) and business plan
Proof of business address and lease/ownership of business premises
application_process: 1. Register on Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in). 2. Submit business proposal and loan application. 3. Application routed to designated commercial bank branch. 4. Bank conducts appraisal and sanctions credit.
source: SIDBI & Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
tags: standup india, women entrepreneur, sc st loan, business loan, 10 lakh to 1 crore, greenfield

name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_audience: Women or girls (or legal guardian on behalf of a minor girl)
short_description: High-interest (7.5% fixed p.a.) 2-year term deposit scheme offering secure government returns for women.
full_description: Introduced by the Ministry of Finance to commemorate Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, MSSC is a dedicated small savings scheme for women. It offers an attractive fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded quarterly for a 2-year tenure, with partial withdrawal facility up to 40% after one year.
benefits: Fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded quarterly. Minimum investment of ₹1,000 and maximum of ₹2,00,000 for a flexible 2-year tenure. Up to 40% partial withdrawal allowed after 1 year.

key_rules: Account can be opened by a woman for herself, or by a guardian on behalf of a minor girl.
Maximum deposit limit of ₹2 Lakh per individual across all MSSC accounts.
A time gap of minimum 3 months between opening two MSSC accounts by the same individual.

required_documents: KYC documents and passport size photograph
Birth certificate (in case of minor girl)
application_process: 1. Visit any Department of Posts (Post Office) branch or authorized commercial bank. 2. Submit MSSC Account Opening Form with KYC documents. 3. Deposit money via cash/cheque/transfer. 4. Certificate passbook issued.
source: Department of Economic Affairs & India Post
tags: mahila samman, mssc, fixed deposit, high interest, savings, women finance, postal scheme

name: One Stop Centre (OSC / Sakhi) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_audience: Women affected by violence in private or public spaces, irrespective of age, marital status, or background
short_description: Integrated 24x7 emergency shelter, medical aid, police assistance, psycho-social counseling, and legal support under one roof.
full_description: Formulated under the Nirbhaya Fund framework, Sakhi One Stop Centres facilitate access to an integrated range of services including medical aid, police assistance, psycho-social counseling, legal aid, and temporary shelter (up to 5 days) for women affected by domestic violence, harassment, sexual assault, and trafficking.
benefits: Free 24x7 emergency response and rescue. Immediate medical examination, free legal aid through District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), trauma counseling, shelter, food, and clothing. Linked directly with Women Helpline 181.

key_rules: Any woman or girl facing violence, harassment, threat, or exploitation in domestic, workplace, or public sphere.
Girls below 18 years are linked with POCSO Act and Child Welfare Committees (CWC).
Completely free of charge with guaranteed confidentiality.

required_documents: None required for emergency admission. ID proof can be provided later.
application_process: Dial 181 (Women Helpline) or 112 (Emergency Response Support System), or walk into the nearest Sakhi One Stop Centre located in district headquarters / hospital campuses.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development
tags: sakhi, one stop centre, women helpline 181, domestic violence, legal aid, shelter, nirbhaya

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_audience: Urban street vendors, hawkers, thela-walas, and small roadside merchants
short_description: Affordable collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and digital cashback.
full_description: PM SVANidhi was launched to empower urban street vendors to resume their livelihoods and transition into the formal financial fold. Vendors can avail an initial working capital loan of up to ₹10,000. On timely repayment, they graduate to second tranche of ₹20,000 and third tranche of ₹50,000, with a 7% interest subvention and up to ₹1,200 annual cashback on digital transactions.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital credit: 1st tranche up to ₹10,000 (1 yr tenure), 2nd tranche up to ₹20,000, 3rd tranche up to ₹50,000. 7% per annum interest subsidy directly credited via DBT. Cashback up to ₹100 per month (₹1,200/year) on UPI digital transactions.

key_rules: Applicant must be engaged in street vending in urban or peri-urban areas.
Possession of Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULB) OR a Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
Operational bank account linked with Aadhaar.
No previous default in formal institutional micro-loans.

required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/Town Vending Committee
application_process: 1. Verify vending status via Town Vending Committee survey list or obtain LoR from ULB. 2. Submit loan application online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through CSC. 3. Select preferred lending bank/NBFC. 4. Digital sanction and direct disbursement into account.
source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & myScheme Portal
tags: street vendor, loan, working capital, small business, urban, collateral-free, mudra, subsidy

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_audience: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 designated trades
short_description: ₹15,000 free toolkit grant, 5-7 days skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and up to ₹3 Lakh collateral-free loan at concessional 5% interest.
full_description: Central sector scheme designed to uplift and preserve the guru-shishya parampara of traditional artisans and craftspeople. Covers 18 trades (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Sculptors, Cobblers, Masons, Barbers, Tailors, Washermen, etc.) with end-to-end support including PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, basic/advanced skill training, modern toolkits, collateral-free enterprise loans, and marketing support.
benefits: Free PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card. Basic skill training (5-7 days) with ₹500/day stipend. ₹15,000 digital toolkit incentive voucher. Collateral-free enterprise loan up to ₹1,00,000 (1st tranche) and ₹2,00,000 (2nd tranche) at concessional 5% interest rate (8% interest subvention paid by MoMSME).

key_rules: An artisan or craftsperson working with their hands and tools in one of the 18 designated family-based traditional trades.
Minimum age of 18 years on date of application.
Beneficiary should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes like PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra in the past 5 years.
Only one member of the family is eligible.

required_documents: Trade verification proof / Gram Panchayat recommendation
application_process: 1. Free biometric registration at Common Service Centre (CSC) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in. 2. Three-stage verification: Gram Panchayat / ULB level, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee. 3. Certificate issued, training initiated, and credit sanctioned.
source: Ministry of MSME & National Council for Vocational Education and Training
tags: vishwakarma, artisan, craftsperson, carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, toolkit grant, 5 percent loan

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_audience: Prospective entrepreneurs, rural youth, women, and self-help groups establishing new micro-enterprises
short_description: 15% to 35% government capital subsidy on bank-financed micro-enterprise projects up to ₹50 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹20 Lakh (services).
full_description: PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy programme administered by Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) as the national nodal agency. It facilitates self-employment generation by establishing micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors through bank loans and upfront margin money capital subsidies.
benefits: Capital subsidy of 15% (urban) to 25% (rural) for General category; and 25% (urban) to 35% (rural) for Special categories (SC, ST, OBC, Women, Ex-Servicemen, Divyangjan, Minorities). Maximum project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service units.

key_rules: Individual must be at least 18 years old. No income ceiling for setting up projects.
For projects costing above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing and above ₹5 Lakh in service sector, beneficiary must possess minimum Class 8 pass qualification.
Only new projects (greenfield units) are sanctioned. Existing units are not eligible for first-stage subsidy.

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machinery quotations
Special Category Certificate (Caste / Disability / Ex-Servicemen certificate if applicable)
Rural Area Certificate from Gram Panchayat / Tehsildar (for rural subsidy rate)
application_process: 1. Apply online on PMEGP e-Portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal). 2. Submit DPR and select financing bank branch. 3. District Task Force Committee (DTFC) reviews application. 4. Bank conducts appraisal and releases loan with KVIC subsidy parked as TDR for 3 years.
source: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) & MoMSME
tags: pmegp, business subsidy, kvic, micro enterprise, start business, manufacturing loan, margin money

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
name_hindi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (मनरेगा)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_audience: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
short_description: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household doing unskilled manual work.
full_description: MGNREGA is the world's largest social security and public works programme. It guarantees 100 days of wage employment per financial year to adult members of any rural household volunteering for unskilled manual labor, creating durable community assets like ponds, wells, check dams, and rural roads.
benefits: Statutory wage rate (₹230 to ₹375 per day depending on state) credited directly into bank/post office account via DBT within 15 days of work. Entitled to unemployment allowance if employment is not provided within 15 days of application.

key_rules: Applicant must be an adult resident of a rural area in the respective Gram Panchayat.
Willing to undertake unskilled manual labour.
Must hold a valid MGNREGA Job Card issued by the Gram Panchayat.
Aadhaar-based Payment System (ABPS) enabled bank account.

required_documents: Bank / Post Office Account Passbook (ABPS enabled)
application_process: 1. Submit written application or oral request for work to Gram Panchayat / Programme Officer. 2. Dated receipt issued to applicant. 3. Work allocated within 5 km radius within 15 days. 4. Fortnightly muster roll measurement and wage DBT credit.
source: Ministry of Rural Development (nrega.nic.in)
tags: mgnrega, nrega, guaranteed work, rural employment, daily wage, job card, dbt wage

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana - Shishu Loan (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_audience: Micro-entrepreneurs, small shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, and self-employed individuals
short_description: Collateral-free institutional micro loan up to ₹50,000 for setting up or running small business activities.
full_description: PMMY was launched to fund the unfunded by bringing non-corporate small business enterprises into formal banking fold. Under the Shishu category, first-time entrepreneurs and small shopkeepers can secure micro credit up to ₹50,000 with zero processing fees and no third-party collateral.
benefits: Collateral-free loan up to ₹50,000 repayable in flexible monthly installments up to 5 years. Zero processing fee for Shishu category loans. Mudra RuPay debit card issued for working capital withdrawals.

key_rules: Borrower must be an Indian citizen with a viable non-farm income generating business plan.
Must not be a defaulter to any commercial bank, cooperative bank, or NBFC.
Loan must be utilized for business activity (working capital or small asset purchase).

required_documents: Proof of residence and business address
Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased or business outline
Bank Account statement for past 6 months (if existing account holder)
application_process: 1. Apply online via Udyami Mitra / JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or visit any commercial bank/MFI. 2. Fill standard 1-page PMMY Shishu application. 3. Bank sanctions loan and issues Mudra card within 7-10 working days.
source: MUDRA & Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
tags: mudra loan, shishu, collateral free loan, 50000 loan, small shop, micro credit, pmmy

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana - Kishore Loan (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_audience: Growing small business enterprises requiring equipment purchase or working capital expansion
short_description: Collateral-free business enterprise loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 with flexible tenures up to 5 years.
full_description: The Kishore category under PMMY caters to micro and small business enterprises that are already established and looking to expand operations, purchase equipment, or increase working capital. Loans are guaranteed by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU).
benefits: Credit facility between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000 without requiring physical collateral. Interest rates tied to bank benchmark MCLR/EBLR. Repayment tenure up to 60 months with moratorium option.

key_rules: Small enterprise with a viable business model requiring credit between ₹50,000 and ₹5 Lakh.
No past loan defaults in CIBIL/Credit bureau records.
Must be registered (Udyam Registration recommended).

required_documents: Business address proof and lease deed/utility bill
Projected balance sheet / sales estimates for next financial year
application_process: 1. Apply through JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or visit bank branch. 2. Upload KYC and business performance figures. 3. In-principle approval and sanction within 14 days.
source: MUDRA & Department of Financial Services
tags: mudra kishore, business expansion, equipment loan, working capital, collateral free, 5 lakh loan

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
target_audience: School/college dropouts, unemployed youth, and informal workers seeking certified vocational skills
short_description: Free industry-aligned certified skill training, assessment, NSDC certification, post-placement support, and accident insurance.
full_description: PMKVY 4.0 is the flagship outcome-based skill training scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) executed by National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). It offers Short Term Training (STT) and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) in modern domains including Industry 4.0, AI, robotics, healthcare, drone technology, green energy, and construction.
benefits: 100% free government-sponsored training and assessment. Sector Skill Council / NCVET recognized certificate. Daily conveyance allowance and ₹500 stipend upon passing certification. Direct placement linkages with industry employers.

key_rules: Indian national aged 15 to 45 years with an Aadhaar card and active bank account.
Unemployed youth or school/college dropouts possessing foundational educational qualification required for the specific job role.
Must attend minimum 70% mandatory practical and theory training classes at accredited centre.

required_documents: Educational Marksheets (8th/10th/12th as applicable to course)
application_process: 1. Register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in). 2. Find accredited PMKVY training centre and desired course job role. 3. Complete course module and undergo biometric assessment. 4. Digital Certificate delivered on Skill India Locker.
source: National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) & MSDE
tags: skill training, pmkvy, free vocational course, certified electrician, computer course, job placement

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_audience: Homeless families and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 (plain areas) and ₹1,30,000 (hilly/difficult areas) for building a 25 sq.m. pucca house.
full_description: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all rural families who are homeless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses. Beneficiaries are identified using housing deprivation parameters in the SECC 2011 and Awaas+ survey list, verified by the Gram Sabha.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/NE/difficult areas released directly via DBT in 3-4 construction milestones. Convergence with MGNREGA provides 90-95 person-days of unskilled labor wages (approx. ₹20,000+) and ₹12,000 under Swachh Bharat Mission for toilet construction. Free LPG connection under Ujjwala and electricity connection under Saubhagya.

key_rules: Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Household must be listed in SECC 2011 permanent waitlist (PWL) or verified Awaas+ survey list.
Houses built must have minimum area of 25 sq.m. including a dedicated hygienic cooking space.
Exclusion criteria: Households possessing motorized 2/3/4-wheelers, mechanized agricultural equipment, or paying income tax are excluded.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked for DBT)
Consent letter for geo-tagging of existing kutcha house site
application_process: 1. Identification from SECC 2011 / Awaas+ list by Gram Panchayat. 2. Gram Sabha validates priority list. 3. Block Development Officer (BDO) geo-tags kutcha site and sanctions order on AwaasSoft (pmayg.nic.in). 4. Payments released automatically as photos are geo-tagged at foundation, lintel, and roof levels.
source: Ministry of Rural Development (pmayg.nic.in)
tags: pmay, housing, awas yojana, pucca house, rural housing, home grant, mgnrega convergence

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U / BLC)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_audience: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Low Income Group (LIG) families in statutory towns
short_description: Central financial assistance of up to ₹1,50,000 for individual house construction / enhancement under Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC).
full_description: PMAY-U addresses the housing shortage among urban poor including slum dwellers. Under the Beneficiary-Led individual house Construction/enhancement (BLC) vertical, eligible families belonging to EWS category receive central assistance of ₹1.5 Lakh (supplemented by state government assistance) to build a new pucca house on their own land.
benefits: Central assistance of ₹1,50,000 per house (combined with state subsidy of ₹50,000 - ₹1,00,000 totaling up to ₹2.5 Lakh). All houses must have toilet, water, electricity, and kitchen. Ownership must be in the name of the female head or joint ownership.

key_rules: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name or any family member's name anywhere in India.
Annual household income must be up to ₹3,00,000 for EWS category.
Beneficiary must own clear land title / patta within municipal statutory town limits.
House title must include the adult female head of the family.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Land Title deed / Registered ownership papers / Urban Patta
Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar / Competent Authority
Photograph of existing site / kutcha structure
application_process: 1. Apply online on PMAY-U MIS portal (pmaymis.gov.in) or via municipal corporation / CSC. 2. Urban Local Body conducts biometric and land title verification. 3. Project approved in State Level Sanctioning Committee. 4. Construction funds released in geo-tagged installments.
source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & myScheme Portal
tags: pmay urban, blc, urban housing, house subsidy, ews, slum rehabilitation, municipal corporation

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
target_audience: Every rural household across all villages of India
short_description: Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) providing 55 liters per capita per day of potable drinking water on a long-term basis.
full_description: Jal Jeevan Mission aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to all rural households in India. Emphasizes community-led water management, greywater treatment, rainwater harvesting, and water quality testing by Village Water & Sanitation Committees (VWSC) / Paani Samitis.
benefits: Free installation of piped drinking water tap connection directly inside household premises. Supply of tested potable water (minimum 55 liters per person per day) meeting BIS 10500 standards, eliminating water fetching drudgery for women and girls.

key_rules: Universal coverage: Every rural household located in the village revenue area.
Schools, Anganwadi centres, Gram Panchayat buildings, and health sub-centres also receive free connections.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card (for household head verification on JJM dashboard)
application_process: Approach Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC) or Gram Panchayat. Piped distribution network and tap metering is implemented community-wide under Village Action Plan (VAP).
source: Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
tags: jal jeevan, drinking water, tap water, har ghar jal, rural water, paani samiti, water connection
